title: M3-PG footer
description: An ink-dark closing band on the 4-column grid: a big short mark, a quiet grey invitation, and an enquiry form of bare underline fields (two by two, then a full-width message), a consent line and an underlined send link; then address, site links and social links in three columns, the full company name in bold type fitted edge to edge, a hairline and a four-part legal row. Links underline on hover.
notes: the band is the theme's ink (bg-foreground) with paper text: under a dark theme it turns into a light band
the wordmark is sized in container units; tune wordmarkSize to the name's length so it fills the width
the form is plain HTML (posts to formAction); wire it up as you like
